text:
Ana: Quick sync — we need a fast copy surgery for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Goal: align launch posts, benchmark narrative, webinar hooks, and inbound routing. 2-day sprint? :scissors:
Mike: +1. Recommendation: headline split by core value — Hosted = speed, Dedicated = predictable throughput, Private = security/control. Keep hero 8–10 words.
Jen: I can ship hero variants today. Any constraints on length or tone? Conversational but engineering-safe.
Luis: Tone: technical but benefit-first. For inbound routing, prefer these CTAs: Hosted -> 'Try Hosted API', Dedicated -> 'Talk capacity & pricing', Private -> 'Request private deployment'. Also add webinar CTA: 'Join launch webinar'.
Olivia: I’ll prototype hero layouts and a simple comparison band (3 cards). Need the final phrasing by EOD tomorrow to lock visuals.
Jen: Draft heroes (quick):
```
Hosted: "Production LLM inference, minutes to ship."
Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity, predictable throughput."
Private: "Your data, your network — enterprise inference."
```
Jen: Quick bullets for each page (draft):
- Hosted: instant API, streaming, usage-based pricing, free dev quota.
- Dedicated: reserved GPUs, autoscale policies, SLA-backed latency targets.
- Private: VPC + on-prem options, KMS/HSM, audit logs.
Mike: Nice. For benchmark narrative we should surface 3 datapoints: median token latency, $/1M tokens, and throughput (reqs/sec). Use conservative numbers and link to a benchmark doc.
Luis: Agreed. Also add a short 'how we compare' row — routing/fallback, caching, quantization recommendations. Keep comparisons factual.
Jen: Microcopy for CTAs + lead routing matrix (short):
```
Hosted CTA: "Start free — Hosted API" -> signups -> self-serve onboarding flow
Dedicated CTA: "Discuss Dedicated" -> leads -> sales SDR -> capacity scoping
Private CTA: "Request Private" -> leads -> solutions eng -> security review
Webinar CTA: "Save my seat" -> marketing -> webinar funnel
```
Olivia: For the page fold, proposed order: hero, 3-value cards, benchmark snapshot (chart), feature bullets, customer logos, CTAs + webinar.
Mike: For launch posts & webinar copy: headline + 2 supporting bullets + demo tease. We should craft a 90s demo script that shows hosted latency then dedicated scaling.
Jen: I'll draft the launch post and webinar email copy after the heroes. Target: 3 short launch posts (product, platform, enterprise angles).
Ana: Timeline check: Day 1 = hero + bullets + CTAs. Day 2 = benchmark chart + visuals + launch post drafts + routing matrix. Friday morning internal review. Sounds good?
Mike: Sounds good. I can prep benchmark numbers and the demo script.
Luis: I'll map the inbound routing in HubSpot and add UTM templates for each CTA.
Olivia: Will deliver mockups by EOD tomorrow.
LaunchBot: Checklist created: [copy heroes, bullets, CTA routing, benchmark numbers, mockups, launch post drafts, webinar script]. Mark items as done in the thread when complete. :white_check_mark:
Jen: Tagging this as 'copy-sprint' in our project board. I'll post first hero drafts in #marketing later today for quick feedback.
Ana: Perfect — small fast loop. Thanks everyone.
